Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Butter-Smooth 60–120fps Scrolling Across Every Screen & Shelf:
   - Eliminated per-frame scroll layout thrashing & CSS transform collisions on
     posters and headings so scrolling stays locked to Android's native compositor.
   - Removed 60–120 per-frame real-time blur passes from tiny poster badges and
     fixed bars while keeping crisp rich surfaces.
   - Released lingering GPU card layers after entrance animations finish, paused
     background badge lookups while actively flinging, made all touch/scroll
     listeners passive, and unlocked flicker-free native 90/120Hz scrolling.

2. Signature Violet Default Theme Across Entire App:
   - Signature Violet (#a65be4) is the default app colour across all WebView
     screens, splash intro, Detail v2 badges/buttons, Browse pills, Account Hub,
     native dialogs, status/navigation bars, and video player HUD (with all 20
     accents still selectable in Settings).

3. Network Unblock, Faster Loading & Device Compatibility:
   - Built-in Encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 & Google 8.8.8.8) ISP
     Unblocker: automatically bypasses carrier DNS blocks with no VPN needed.
   - 8-Worker HTTP/2 Connection Pool + 90s AniList Metadata Cache + 12 MB Poster
     RAM Cache + ExoPlayer Software Video Decoder Fallback.
   - Safe 1-Tap Temp Cache Cleaner inside Settings -> Network & compatibility.
   - Full Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV Stick (Leanback Launcher + Violet TV
     Banner + auto Desktop/DPAD mode on TVs), Foldable continuity, and Low-RAM
     WebView Crash Shield.

4. Hardened Multi-Layer Player Popup & In-Page-Push Ad Blocker + Android 15 Insets:
   - Blocks Adsterra, ExoClick, Monetag, Galaksion, AdCash, AdSpyglass, Clickadu,
     HilltopAds, and Shadow-DOM floating banners; keeps header clear of status bar.

5. Unified Account, Trackers & Discord Rich Presence Hub + 24 Manga PFPs/Banners:
   - Kuro Cloud Account card, AniList & MAL 2-Way Sync, Discord Rich Presence hub,
     and 24 real manga face PFPs + matching 16:9 banners (art-11 .. art-34).
